name: New Argive
description: New Argive is a nation and the largest of the Terisian Isles on Dominaria, formed by Kjeldor and Balduvia after the Ice Age and known for its archaeologists, historians and walled fortifications.

timeline.summary: Around 4560 AR the Blackblade comes into the possession of the Cabal minion Needle, and the Cabal rewrites its origins.
timeline.quote: would come into the possession of the Cabal minion Needle

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "Reforged". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon steals the Blackblade from the Cabal vaults and confronts Belzenlok; Liliana's taunting lets Gideon lodge it in the demon's leg and Liliana activates its curse, draining Belzenlok's soul.
timeline.quote: Liliana grasped its hilt and activated its curse, draining Belzenlok's soul

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "Reforged". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Twenty years into the Thaw, Darien and Lovisa merge their nations into New Argive and fight the Battle of Kjeldor.
timeline.quote: planned for their two nations to be merged into New Argive

citation.text: "Darien Kjeld", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah convinces Darien and Lovisa Coldeyes to stop fighting and cooperate, leading to the merger into New Argive.
timeline.quote: This cooperation would eventually result in the merger of the two countries into New Argive

citation.text: "Kjeldor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alexandrite and Lothar marry, creating the royal house of New Argive.
timeline.quote: The royal house of this new nation was created in the marriage of Alexandrite

citation.text: "Kjeldor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eskil takes Embereck to New Argive, where Embereck tells of recovering the Golgothian Sylex and showing mercy to Ravidel.
timeline.quote: This convinced the more powerful planeswalker to hand over the Sylex to the Battle Mage.

citation.text: "Prelude to War", section "Dragon's Dance , by David Quinn , Kenny Martinez and Anibal Rodriguez". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yotia falls to Mishra's dragon engines, and Urza retreats to Argive where he is named Lord Protector.
timeline.quote: Urza retreats to Argive where he is named Lord Protector

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At New Argive, Rith lets four dragon lords incinerate themselves with mana, and Treva is reborn; Darigaaz forbids further mortal sacrifices.
timeline.quote: the sacrifice worked and Treva was reborn.

citation.text: "Darigaaz", section "Freeing Treva". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Darien fulfills his dream of unification and becomes the last king of Kjeldor.
timeline.quote: With his dream of unification fulfilled, Darien became the last king of Kjeldor.

citation.text: Darien, King of Kjeldor (Coldsnap, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Heidar allies with the Order of Stromgald and Krov to locate relics and gain protection from New Argive.
timeline.quote: Heidar allied with the undead Order of Stromgald and their leader Haakon

citation.text: "Cult of Rimewind", section "The Rise of Heidar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Stenn meets Karn on a hill, telling him King Darien tasked him with finding Phyrexian agents and that New Argive will mobilize.
timeline.quote: New Argive will mobilize.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The nation of New Argive is formed by Balduvia and Kjeldor after the Ice Age.
timeline.quote: The nation of New Argive was formed in 2954 AR by Balduvia and Kjeldor after the end of Dominaria's Ice Age

citation.text: "New Argive", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sheoltun Empire conquers New Argive.
timeline.quote: New Argive was conquered by the Sheoltun Empire based out of Benfosa

citation.text: "New Argive", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Argivians push out the Sheoltun with the songmage Thabit and his summoned Serra Angels.
timeline.quote: The Argivians were able to push the Sheoltun out with the aid the songmage Thabit and his summoned Serra Angels .

citation.text: "New Argive", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn arrives in New Argive via a time travel experiment and finds the aftermath of a battle.
timeline.quote: Karn witnessed the aftermath of a grueling battle with many dead humans .

citation.text: "New Argive", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: New Argive is devastated during the second phase of the Phyrexian Invasion but recovers, then faces infiltration by Cabal agents.

citation.text: "New Argive", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Argive joins with Korlis in 36 AR to form the Combined Kingdoms, with Urza as Lord High Protector.
timeline.quote: Argive joined with Korlis in 36 AR to form the Combined Kingdoms

citation.text: "Argive", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Argive", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kjeldor is founded in the area of the old Argive around 2400 AR.
timeline.quote: the nation of Kjeldor would be founded in the same area that Argive had been

citation.text: "Argive", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the World Spell and Thaw, Balduvia's lands become farmable; Balduvians and Kjeldorans form New Argive.
timeline.quote: Together they formed the nation of New Argive

citation.text: "Balduvia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Penregon, capital of Argive, falls to creeping frost.
timeline.quote: its walls and towers consumed by the creeping advance of frost from the northern ridges of Terisiare

citation.text: "Dark Age", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As temperatures kept rising, Argive's larger cities fell apart, leaving farmsteads and villages known as the Northern Provinces.
timeline.quote: the larger cities of old were unable to sustain themselves and fell apart

citation.text: "Northern Provinces", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Raff heals Teferi of a grave wound from a Phyrexian attack in the watchtower of New Argive.

citation.text: "Raff Capashen", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Cult of Rimewind fails to undo the Thaw; New Argive secures control and the Order of Stromgald is defeated.
timeline.quote: tried to halt and undo the Thaw with their ice magic but ultimately failed

citation.text: "The Thaw", section "The Flood Ages (2934 to 3000 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: New Argive forms and rallies against Varchild, stealing her troops and ending her crusade.
